title: Optimization with Region-Reduced ReLU Neural Networks
summary: Optimization of mathematical models involving integer decisions and neural networks with ReLU activation (ReLU ANNs) is a challenging task. Nevertheless, such models are an enabling technology in many application domains. A prominent example is superstructure optimization in chemical engineering, where ReLU ANNs are frequently employed as surrogate models for complex nonlinear processes. We survey recent developments in this area.
